environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 with a custom AppArmor profile (jwt-api-confined) loaded via aa-enforce. The profile grants the dotnet process execute and mmap permissions on /usr/share/dotnet/** and read access to /app/**. The profile includes a DENY rule on /etc/jwt/** with audit logging — specifically: 'deny /etc/jwt/** r,' and 'deny /etc/jwt/** w,'. The container runs with --security-opt apparmor=jwt-api-confined. The application process cannot read or write any files under /etc/jwt/ at runtime. Note: the profile does NOT restrict network access or memory operations, and the application binary itself is unchanged.
